page.layout: One page, a printed index. Running head "INDEX." at the top. Below it, the letter T with its entries, then the letter X with one entry. Then "FINIS." and a woodcut ornament. Below the ornament, a few lines of small printed text. A library stamp at the foot is left out.

main_text.l: Thebanorum imperium regium. 92. & libertatis initium. ibid. pessum ivit. 98. 105

page.notes: The woodcut ornament below FINIS is a decorative flourish with a central mask, not text. The lines of small type under the ornament are faint and only partly legible; the readings are doubtful and marked as illegible or [?]. The large T and X are decorative initials, joined to the first word. The faint text on the right side of the page is show-through from the other side and is not transcribed. The page number is not visible on this scan. The library stamp at the foot is not transcribed.
